label: basic-fork-resolve
description: Spawn a single fork and resolve it with a string value

input.task: Fork a task that computes 'hello world'. Await the fork result with inspect().

label: fork-resolve-number
description: Fork computes a numeric result and resolves it

input.task: Fork a task that resolves with n * 2. Await the result with inspect().

label: fork-with-instruction
description: Fork with a clear instruction and resolve an object

input.task: Spawn a fork with instruction 'build a summary object'. Inside fork context resolve({summary:'done',count:3}). Await and inspect the result.

label: fork-resolve-never
description: Understand that resolve() is typed as never — code after it is unreachable

input.task: In a fork context, resolve(true). Do not write any statements after the resolve() call.

label: fork-handle-properties
description: Demonstrate that fork() returns handle with forkId and inject()

input.task: Spawn a fork and log forkId from the handle. Resolve and inspect the result.

label: fork-inspect-await
description: Pass fork handle to inspect() to block until fork completes

input.task: Spawn a fork that resolves with 'done'. Pass the fork handle to inspect() to await it.

label: fork-inspect-multiple
description: Spawn a fork and pass handle along with other vars to inspect()

input.task: Spawn a fork, resolve inside, pass both label and forkHandle to inspect().

label: fork-inspect-result-destructure
description: After fork resolves, inspect the ForkResult fields

input.task: Spawn a fork, await it, then inspect the status, value, and tokensUsed fields.

label: fork-with-exclude
description: Fork with exclude list to limit seeded scope

input.task: Spawn a fork with exclude: ['secret'] to avoid leaking it. Resolve with data.length. Inspect result.

label: fork-with-token-budget
description: Specify a tokenBudget cap on a fork

input.task: Spawn a fork with tokenBudget: 2000 that resolves with 'ok'. Inspect the fork handle.

label: budget-warning-check
description: Check Budget.nearingLimit and wrap up before budget is exhausted

input.task: Spawn a fork with warnAt: 500. Inside the fork, check budget().nearingLimit and if true, resolve('wrapped up') immediately. Inspect.

label: budget-warning-resolve-soon
description: When fork budget warning fires, resolve quickly

input.task: You are in a fork context. Budget.nearingLimit is true (150 tokens remaining). Resolve immediately with 'budget-limited-result'. No further computation.

label: budget-warning-conditional
description: Conditionally branch on nearingLimit inside fork

input.task: Inside a fork, process items one by one. After each, check budget().nearingLimit — if true, resolve with processed items so far.

label: budget-warning-wrap-up-message
description: Emit a wrap-up resolve when budget warning triggers

input.task: In a fork, if budget().nearingLimit, resolve with {status:'partial',done:false}. Otherwise resolve with {status:'complete',done:true}.

label: budget-warning-avoid-overrun
description: Avoid budget overrun by resolving when warning threshold hit

input.task: In a fork: increment processed in a loop. Check budget after each step. When nearingLimit, resolve({processed}) to avoid budget overrun.

label: two-concurrent-forks
description: Spawn two parallel forks and await both with inspect()

input.task: Spawn forkA and forkB concurrently. forkA resolves with 'A'. forkB resolves with 'B'. Pass both handles to inspect().

label: fork-ask-pattern
description: Fork calls ask() to get user input; parent responds via inject()

input.task: Spawn a fork that needs user confirmation. The fork calls ask() for a yes/no. Parent injects 'yes' via forkHandle.inject(). Resolve based on answer.

label: fork-ask-inject-answer
description: Parent uses forkHandle.inject() to answer fork's pending ask

input.task: The fork has a pending ask. Call forkHandle.inject('confirmed') to provide the answer. Inspect the fork handle.

label: multiple-forks-independent-results
description: Three concurrent forks each resolve independently

input.task: Spawn one fork per task. Each resolves with the task name uppercased. Await all with inspect().

label: fork-ask-then-resolve
description: Fork asks a question and resolves after receiving the answer

input.task: Spawn a fork. Inside: const userChoice = await ask(<TextInput label='Pick a mode' />); resolve({mode: userChoice}). Parent injects 'fast'. Inspect result.
